items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.
items.computation: Page 2 shows a Zustellungsurkunde (formal service record) stating the notice was 'zugestellt am 17.09.2026' (Thursday). For förmliche Zustellung the documented actual delivery date governs rather than the standard postal deemed-delivery fiction. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (17.09.2026) is not counted; the 2-week period begins the next day, 18.09.2026. Two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) ends Thursday 01.10.2026, which is a normal working day in Bayern, so no shift is needed. Confirmed via compute_deadline tool.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße + Gebühr + Auslagen)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the decision becomes 'rechtskräftig' (final). Rechtskraft occurs once the 2-week Einspruch period lapses without an objection being filed, i.e. the day after 01.10.2026, so Rechtskraft = 02.10.2026 (Friday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day is not counted; the 2-week payment period starts 03.10.2026 and ends two weeks later on Friday 16.10.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB), a normal working day in Bayern, so no shift applies. This assumes no Einspruch is filed; if an Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft and this payment deadline no longer apply. Confirmed via compute_deadline tool.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-10-16) depends on the fine becoming legally final, which in turn depends on no Einspruch being filed by 2026-10-01; if an Einspruch is filed, this payment deadline does not apply and a new timeline follows any court decision.

The IBAN on the letter (DE52 7115 0000 0000 0077 07, Sparkasse Musterau) is well-formed and matches the sender's stated bank, but ownership cannot be verified from the IBAN alone — compare it against other correspondence from Stadt Musterau before paying.
